description: Cohort membership of every cochlea in the reproducibility parameter files. Cohorts are grouped into named axes: 'protocol' is the sample preparation and clearing protocol, 'group' is the experimental grouping. A cochlea has at most one cohort per axis and appears in at least one axis. A cochlea that no axis can classify is listed under the 'undefined' group. This file records membership only; plot labels and colors stay in scripts/figures/util.py, and component lists stay with the per-cochlea parameters.

PELCOfHC1.label: PELCOfHC1
PELCOfHC1.description: Microwave-assisted hybrid clearing, first protocol revision.

PELCOfHC2.label: PELCOfHC2
PELCOfHC2.description: Microwave-assisted hybrid clearing, second protocol revision.

PELCOfHC2longnoDCM.label: MWfLS
PELCOfHC2longnoDCM.description: Microwave-assisted hybrid clearing with long incubation and without dichloromethane. Same cochleae as the 'mwfls' group.

chreef_mouse.label: ChReef mouse
chreef_mouse.description: ChReef optogenetic therapy. The left cochlea is injected, the right one is not. M_LR_000143 is the pilot animal.

fchrimson_gerbil.label: f-Chrimson gerbil
fchrimson_gerbil.description: f-Chrimson optogenetic therapy. G_EK_000049 was injected postnatally, the other animals as adults. The retired ChReef_GEK49*.json filenames named these ChReef, which was wrong: gerbils carry f-Chrimson.

otof_mouse_pilot.label: OTOF mouse pilot
otof_mouse_pilot.description: Pilot cochleae of the OTOF gene therapy, measured on IHC_v2.

otof_lavision.label: OTOF LaVision

lavision_marmoset.label: LaVision marmoset
lavision_marmoset.description: Marmoset cochlea from Keppeler et al., imaged on the LaVision Ultramicroscope. No Greenwood parameters exist for this species.

sgn_subtypes.label: SGN subtypes
sgn_subtypes.description: Cochleae stained for SGN subtype markers.

undefined.label: undefined
undefined.description: No experimental group can be derived. Every appearance is a processing purpose or an isolated measurement.
